coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment)
record.summary: Pedestrian paseo on Bridgeview Street north of Exposition Street (Toni Stone Crossing), next to Block G (the Visa building) and Block K on Pier & Point's mapped geometry. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1, and the Port says Phase 1 public infrastructure, including 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park', has been accepted.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which name this planned street as Bridgeview Street (Design Controls Section 4.4); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sept 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05)

open_questions: No source read names this paseo on its own as built or accepted. The 'complete' status rests on the Port's general statements that Phase 1 public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G, was accepted (Feb 2025 minutes, June 2026 report); the site was not checked against imagery or a site visit.
Acceptance date and construction cost for this paseo are not published separately in any source read.

record.notes: Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment), 1044 Bridgeview Way -- the pedestrian paseo between Block G/Visa and Block K, from Exposition Street (Toni Stone Crossing) to China Basin Park; Design Controls Figure 3.1.1 marks it as Paseo 4.4. Built with Phase 1, per Port records of its acceptance: the 2019 Phase 1 submittal only planned it (Phase 1 'will also complete the Shared Public Way and Bridgeview Street paseos north of Exposition Street'), but the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure and describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 5, 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and 'The City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure'. None of these names this paseo on its own. Its own real Assessor lot, 8719A007 (840 m2, addressed 1044 Bridgeview Way, recorded 2020-06-12); DataSF centerline CNN 15284000 (Bridgeview Way, END: NORTH to Toni Stone Xing, layer PRIVATE). Its east lot line is Block K's west edge. Added 2026-09-17.
